lines: I count losses carefully. I can count an apology too, if it is real.
Rough hands ruin good wool. Gentle choices from here, yes?
A frightened heart remembers rough handling. Be gentler from here.
Fine. I will count the apology, but I will also count what follows.
Trust scatters quickly. Gather it patiently.
Do not chase forgiveness. Walk steady and let it come closer.
I hear you. Keep your hands calm around this village.
Words can be soft. Make your choices soft too.
